pages.text: The highest-cost armor set on the life path: the $(reset)Life Fusion Armor$(reset).$(br2)$(bold)How to obtain it:$(reset) at the "$(l:akaishi:life_fusion_anvil)Life Fusion Anvil$(/l)", fuse 1 piece of Akaishi Armor with 1 "$(reset)Life Fusion Ingot$(reset)".$(li)Fusion Ingots only come from offerings at the "$(l:akaishi:mother_altar)Altar of the Black Mother$(/l)", which is the source of their rarity$(li)The result $(reset)keeps every upgrade and all NBT from the original gear$(reset), enchantments included$(br2)Recommendation: $(reset)fully upgrade your best Akaishi Armor before fusing.$(reset)

$(bold)Stats at a glance$(reset) (2x Akaishi Armor):$(li)Armor: boots 8 / leggings 14 / chestplate 20 / helmet 8$(li)Toughness 8 · Knockback resistance 0.2$(li)Enchantability 25$(li)Durability = vanilla base for that slot × 92$(li)Repair material = Life Fusion Ingot$(br2)Item IDs of the four pieces:$(li)akaishi_life_fusion_helmet$(li)akaishi_life_fusion_chestplate$(li)akaishi_life_fusion_leggings$(li)akaishi_life_fusion_boots

$(bold)Set effects:$(reset)$(li)$(reset)Each piece worn$(reset): every implanted organ gains "$(reset)effective compatibility +2$(reset)" — rejection grows slower and slot debuff thresholds rise$(li)$(reset)All 4 pieces$(reset) unlock the full set:$(br2)$(li)Organ strength ×1.2$(li)Rejection growth ×0.75$(li)On hit, damage is offset by draining portable Akaishi Energy cells in your inventory (100 per point)$(li)+10 max health while an active BOSS/Dragon-source organ is implanted$(li)Gain $(reset)flight with no energy cost$(reset) — take off any piece and it is revoked$(br2)How it plays with your body mods is covered in "$(l:akaishi:life_body)Body & Decay$(/l)".
Read first: the Mother Altar (ingot source) → the Life Fusion Anvil (fusion) → Body & Decay (to pair with implants); configure traits before fusing for the best result.
